top_news.title: SK Hynix Posts Record Profit Amid AI Rush
top_news.summary:
SK Hynix posted a stronger-than-expected seven-fold surge in quarterly profit and unveiled an additional shareholder return program for 2026 worth 100 trillion won ($75 billion), underscoring relentless demand for AI hardware. Counterpoint Research Director MS Hwang puts the results in the context of broader industry trends.

 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Stocks in Asia Advance on Resurgent AI Optimism: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks rose, tracking gains on Wall Street as renewed enthusiasm for the artificial intelligence trade lifted equities ahead of earnings from tech megacaps and the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision.

top_news.title: Dongshan Precision Set to Debut After $1.3 Billion HK Listing
top_news.summary: Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing Co. is set to begin trading in Hong Kong on Wednesday after raising HK$9.9 billion ($1.3 billion), a debut that will test appetite for artificial intelligence-linked listings after a sharp market pullback.

top_news.title: Haiti Crisis: El Salvador Surges Hundreds of Troops to Find Missing Soldiers
top_news.summary: El Salvador’s troop presence in Haiti has swelled to at least 600, according to a top researcher, a reflection of President Nayib Bukele’s efforts to find four kidnapped soldiers in the troubled Caribbean nation.

top_news.title: Prediction Market Betting Stretches Past Sports
top_news.summary: The rapid growth of prediction markets is raising questions about sports wagering, younger traders, market manipulation, and regulation. Sean Patrick Maloney, CEO and President of the Coalition for Prediction Markets, argues federally regulated platforms should be treated as financial markets overseen by a well-funded CFTC, rather than casinos. top_news.title: Wells Fargo, UBS & Citi on Servicing the Texas Wealthy
top_news.summary: Wells Fargo Head of Central Division Wealth & Investment Management Heather Hunt-Ruddy; UBS Managing Director of Global Family & Institutional Wealth William Thompson and Citi Managing Director & Central Region Market Executive Clinton Warren discuss how wealth managers are serving affluent clients relocating to North Texas with Bloomberg’s Sarah McGregor at Bloomberg Invest Dallas 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Nasdaq Texas & Walmart Discuss Corp Listing Strategies
top_news.summary: Nasdaq Texas President Rachel Racz and Walmart Senior Vice President & Head of Investor Relations Stephanie Wissink discuss how exchanges and public companies are navigating listings, investor engagement and long-term shareholder value with Bloomberg's Amanda Cantrell at Bloomberg Invest Dallas 2026.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: JPM's Agather & Herbst on Texas Wealth Wave
top_news.summary: J.P. Morgan Private Bank Global Vice Chair and JPMorgan Chase Dallas Region Chairman, Elaine Agather and J.P. Morgan Private Bank Managing Director & Head of Dallas, Ashley Herbst discuss capital inflows, generational wealth transfer and Texas’ changing investment landscape with Bloomberg’s Joe Lovinger at Bloomberg Invest Dallas 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Montage Intl. CEO: Future Bookings Are Higher Into 2027
top_news.summary: Alan Fuerstman, Founder and CEO of Montage International, said luxury travel demand has remained resilient despite higher costs and geopolitical uncertainty. He described the business as coming off a record year and said future bookings are up going into next year, with record holiday-period bookings at resorts across the U.S. and Mexico. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Banks Eye $21 Billion Bonds for Broadcom Chip-Financing Deal
top_news.summary: Banks are planning to sell as much as about $21 billion of high-grade bonds as soon as early next year as part of a $63 billion funding package that Broadcom Inc. has pulled together to help finance chips for AI developer Anthropic PBC.
